name: Julian Beaumont
source:
Occupation: Being rich

He's running from responsibilities back home—and maybe himself.

Golden retriever energy, cheerful, gullible, full of wonder.

Likes: Vending machines, praising your "local wisdom"

Dislikes: Being ignored, using maps, paper money
